descriptionHtml:
Technical Specifications

The Antec VISION 120 ARGB 3in1 is the standard (Forward Blade) version of the Vision fan series. Unlike the "120R" (Reverse), these are traditional fans where air flows toward the frame/bracket side. They are ideal for top or rear exhaust or front intake in standard cases.

FeatureSpecification
ModelVISION 120 ARGB (3-in-1 Pack)
Fan TypePWM Standard (Forward) Blade Fan
Dimensions120 x 120 x 25 mm
Bearing TypeHydraulic Bearing
Fan Speed600 – 1500 RPM ± 10%
AirflowUp to 62.5 CFM
Static PressureUp to 1.83 mmH2O
